c13.text: Hey Nina! Miss you and your epically curated dinner parties—how's life been? I just launched Ember & Oak gift sets ($28) and immediately thought of your table settings; want me to send you the link to grab one, and is there anyone else you know who'd swoon over these too?

MAYA! omg yes send me the link immediately, I'm obsessed already just from the name. And yes please put me down for one asap. Also — my friend Jess would literally die, she's been on a whole cozy-home kick lately, I'll send her your way too!

c14.text: Hey Chris! How's the engineering life treating you these days? I know candles aren't really your scene, I'm curious if you know anyone who would love them?! — and if you ever want one yourself, happy to hook you up with the friends & family discount.

Hey! Engineering's keeping me busy as always, haha. Congrats on getting Ember & Oak off the ground - that's awesome. Candles really aren't my thing but I'll keep an ear out for anyone who might dig them. Good luck with the launch!

c07.text: Hi Olivia! How's wedding planning going, cousin?? I've been dreaming up a boho-vibe gift set at Ember & Oak that feels so 'you' — want me to send you the link with a friends & family discount to grab one for your registry?

OMG YES send the link!! Wedding planning is consuming my entire brain rn 😩 but a boho gift set that feels like 'me' sounds perfect for the registry, I'm obsessed already. Also you HAVE to tell me everything about the launch!!

Hey Liv! How's wedding planning treating you today — still drowning in Pinterest boards? 😊 So glad the boho set felt like "you" for the registry, that makes me so happy. If you're loving it, you could totally set up a subscription so you never run out before the big day — and if any bridesmaids or wedding guests need gift ideas, send them my way and I'll hook them up with a friends & family discount link.

Omg yes still drowning 😂 but the boho set is seriously my favorite thing on the whole registry, I keep sniffing the sample candle lol. A subscription sounds perfect honestly, I don't want to run out before the big day! And yes!! I'll totally send my bridesmaids your way, a few of them have been asking what to get me anyway 🥰
